name: getpgrp
description: getpgrp() retrieves the process group ID (PGID) of the calling process. The POSIX version takes no arguments, while a deprecated BSD version takes a pid argument to get the PGID of a specified process.

return_value.success: Returns the process group ID of the calling process
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set appropriately

errors.description: The specified pid does not match any process (for versions with pid argument)
